info.title: Syndicate Links
info.description: Attribution and commission infrastructure for AI-driven commerce. Two-sided: merchants publish programs + products; publishers (humans and AI agents) create tracking links and earn commissions. The API powers the rail; this CLI is muscle memory for agents who operate on it.

tags.name: publisher
tags.description: Publisher-side endpoints (a.k.a. affiliate in API paths). Auth: ak_live_* (human) or aff_agent_* (agent).

tags.name: ai-attribution
tags.description: AI surface attribution + agent token issuance.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token: mk_live_* for merchants, ak_live_* or aff_human_* for human publishers, aff_agent_* for agent publishers. The prefix routes the request — merchant keys can only hit /merchant/*, publisher keys can only hit /affiliate/*.

ErrorCoded.description: Coded error shape used by some merchant report endpoints.

defaultCommissionPct.description: Decimal as string. Always parse client-side.

commissionPct.description: Decimal as string. Overrides program default when set.

Affiliate.description: Publisher account. SL uses 'publisher' externally; 'affiliate' is the internal/API term.

sourceTag.description: Free-form label for affiliate-side traffic source attribution.

Event.description: Unified click + conversion record. Use 'type' to discriminate.

referrerContext.description: Free-form JSONB. AI surface metadata lives here (ai_surface, agent_id, acp_transaction_token).

post.description: Returns the API key once — bcrypt-hashed in the DB. No auth required.

post.description: Runs attribution match (clickId → trackingCode → cookie), records the event, charges the tracking fee, fires the conversion webhook. Commission auto-calculated: partnership custom rate > product rate > program default.

clickId.description: Speeds up attribution match when known.

post.description: Full claw-back only — partial refunds are planned but not implemented. Reverses publisher totals and appends a CommissionAdjustment row.
